name: Tray.ai
description_en:
Tray.ai is an integration and automation platform for building workflows that receive data, process it and call other services. Tray Build provides the visual design route, while the wider platform also offers headless development, agent tooling and embedded integration capabilities. The legacy tray.io address now redirects to tray.ai.

The integration runtime uses task-based usage accounting, where repeated steps and loops affect consumption. This profile focuses on workflow data mapping, authentication, error handling and commercial operating conditions. Tray Helix is presented as a separate managed application-runtime offering and is not treated as a workflow-plan entitlement.
description_zh:
Tray.ai 是用于接收数据、处理数据并调用其他服务的集成与自动化平台。Tray Build 提供可视化设计入口，更广的平台还提供无界面开发、Agent 工具及嵌入式集成能力。旧地址 tray.io 当前跳转到 tray.ai。

集成运行按任务计量，重复步骤与循环会影响消耗。本文聚焦数据映射、认证、错误处理及商业运营条件。Tray Helix 是另行介绍的托管应用运行产品，本文不把它算入普通流程套餐权限。

core_features.explanation_zh: 选择自动、手动或继续模式，重试行为随模式变化。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Follow the current product and documentation identity
sections.title_zh: 按当前产品与文档身份研究
sections.en: The old tray.io homepage redirects to tray.ai, and the documentation is now served beneath tray.ai/documentation. This record keeps its original slug for continuity but updates the website identity. The current site distinguishes Tray iPaaS from Tray Helix, and the pricing page separates core integration from Agent Development and other add-ons. Confirm the product on a proposal rather than assuming an old Tray.io description covers every current agent or app-runtime capability.
sections.zh: 旧 tray.io 首页跳转 tray.ai，文档现位于 tray.ai/documentation。本记录保留原 slug 以维持连续性，同时更新官网身份。当前网站区分 Tray iPaaS 与 Tray Helix，定价页也把核心集成与 Agent Development 等附加项分开。应核对报价中的具体产品，不能认为旧 Tray.io 描述覆盖现在所有 Agent 或应用运行能力。

sections.title_en: A trigger starts a data-processing contract
sections.title_zh: 触发器启动一项数据处理约定
sections.en: The quickstart distinguishes service events from scheduled polling. Its example processes Typeform survey responses into Google Sheets and then notifies Slack. It offers static handling for a fixed survey/sheet and dynamic handling that constructs headers and answers for varying surveys. This is more than connecting three app names: the input question/answer arrays must be transformed into the destination’s required row structure. Start by defining which survey types and answer formats your production workflow accepts, then verify one end-to-end result.
sections.zh: 快速入门区分应用事件与定时轮询，示例把 Typeform 问卷回答处理到 Google Sheets，再通知 Slack；既有固定问卷与表格的静态处理，也有为不同问卷动态构造表头和回答的处理。这不只是连接三个应用名称：输入的问题与回答数组必须转换成目标行结构。应先定义生产流程接受哪些问卷及回答格式，再核对一个端到端结果。

sections.title_en: A visible field and a valid runtime path are different checks
sections.title_zh: 界面可见字段与运行路径有效是两项检查
sections.en: Tray’s JSON paths reference the trigger or named connector steps; array indexing begins at zero. A hard-coded first-array-item path selects a position, not necessarily the item your business rule intended. Output-schema suggestions can also need refreshing after a real run, and path names are case-sensitive. For a proposed evaluation, process a reordered array and a missing optional answer, then inspect the target input rather than only the mapping dropdown. Use a deliberate fallback or branch when data is absent; a default empty string can silently change business meaning.
sections.zh: Tray 的 JSON 路径引用触发器或命名连接器步骤，数组下标从零开始。写死第一个数组元素选中的是位置，不一定是业务规则想要的项目。真实运行后，输出 schema 建议也可能需要更新，路径区分大小写。建议测试数组顺序变化及可选回答缺失，并检查目标输入，而不只看映射下拉菜单。数据缺失时应明确选择回退值或分支，默认空字符串可能悄然改变业务含义。

sections.title_en: Authentication location changes who can reuse it
sections.title_zh: 认证存放范围影响谁可复用
sections.en: The authentication guide distinguishes personal, organization and workspace credentials. Connector-specific instructions define OAuth scopes and other requirements, and changing credential settings requires re-authentication. Generic Service Authentication cannot cover complex token/OAuth schemes; a custom service may be needed. Our suggested connection naming includes the environment and business account, so a test workflow is not accidentally wired to a production destination. A successful sign-in is only the first check: test the precise read or write operation under the intended user scope.
sections.zh: 认证指南区分个人、组织及工作区凭据，OAuth scope 等要求以具体连接器文档为准，修改凭据设置需重新认证。Generic Service Authentication 不能覆盖复杂 token／OAuth 方案，可能需要自定义 service。建议连接名称包含环境与业务账户，避免测试流程误连生产目标。登录成功只是第一步，还应在预期用户范围下测试具体读写操作。

sections.title_en: Loop work and AI usage change the task budget
sections.title_zh: 循环处理与 AI 用量会改变任务预算
sections.en: Usage documentation treats executed workflow steps as tasks, which need not equal the underlying API-call count. Loops include iteration and final-check work, so multiplying visible action cards by records can undercount. As a planning example, a trigger, a loop over three records, one action per record and a final loop check total eight tasks if those are the only executed steps. AI input/output tokens convert using contract-specific ratios; document processing has page units. Isolated-step tests are also billable under the current guide. Validate counters against representative runs; the example is arithmetic, not a measured invoice.
sections.zh: 用量文档将已执行流程步骤作为任务，未必等于底层 API 调用数量。循环包括迭代及最后检查，仅把可见动作卡片数乘记录数可能低估。假设仅执行一个触发器、遍历三条记录的循环、每条一个动作及最后一次循环检查，合计八个任务。AI 输入与输出 token 按具体合同比例换算，文档处理使用页数单位；现行指南还说明独立步骤测试可计费。应以代表性运行核对计数，本例只是算术估算，并非真实账单。

sections.title_en: Continuing after an error changes the delivery contract
sections.title_zh: 遇错继续会改变交付含义
sections.en: Automatic mode retries according to error type. Manual handling creates success/failure paths, while Continue advances despite failure; with legacy handling off, these latter modes do not retain automatic retry behavior. Loop-specific break/continue options add another scope. Some APIs return an empty result rather than an HTTP error, so an error handler alone will not catch “record not found.” Test absent results, an invalid path and a transient service error separately. If you continue, record how the rejected item will be reconciled rather than equating workflow completion with delivery.
sections.zh: 自动模式按错误类型重试；手动处理产生成功与失败路径，Continue 则忽略失败向后执行。关闭旧错误处理时，后两类模式不会保留自动重试行为；循环还有退出或继续迭代选项。有些 API 在未找到记录时返回空结果而非 HTTP 错误，因此只配置错误处理抓不到这种情况。应分别测试空结果、无效路径及暂时服务故障。选择继续时，需记录拒绝项目如何对账，不能把流程完成等同交付完成。

sections.en: The official page lists Pro, Team and Enterprise and requests a usage-specific quote; no public amount was established. Pro shows three workspaces and seven-day log retention, Team expands workspace and management scope, and Enterprise adds broader hosting/connectivity capabilities. Agent Development and several governance or data features have add-on scope. A free trial is available through sales, without a duration established here. Keep plan fees, task entitlements, token conversion and required log retention in the same cost comparison. Do not treat insights history as equivalent to retained execution payloads.
sections.zh: 官方页面列出 Pro、Team、Enterprise，需按用量询价，本次未确认公开金额。Pro 显示三个工作区及七天日志保留，Team 扩大工作区和管理范围，Enterprise 增加更广托管与连接能力。Agent Development 及若干治理、数据功能有附加范围。可通过销售获得免费试用，本文未确认时长。比较费用时，应同时考虑套餐费、任务权限、token 换算及所需日志保留，不能把 insights 历史等同执行负载保留。

sections.title_en: Private connectivity does not imply a fully self-hosted platform
sections.title_zh: 私有连接不等于整个平台自托管
sections.en: The on-prem agent connects Tray’s connectors to internal services and databases without exposing those services publicly. The guide also describes AWS networking options and a site-to-site VPN, which has its own network setup work. Those are connectivity arrangements; they do not establish a free, downloadable self-hosted workflow platform. Determine endpoint reachability, credentials, network ownership and plan entitlement with the actual architecture. No agent was installed, no VPN was configured and no data-residency or restoration result was tested in this research.
sections.zh: 本地 Agent 让 Tray 连接器访问内部服务及数据库，无需将这些服务公开到互联网；指南还介绍 AWS 网络选项及需要网络配置工作的站点间 VPN。这些是连接安排，不能证明存在免费可下载的完整自托管流程平台。应按实际架构明确端点可达性、凭据、网络负责人及套餐权限。本文未安装 Agent、配置 VPN，也未测试数据存储地区或恢复结果。

sections.title_en: Adopt only with a workflow owner and a record-level test
sections.title_zh: 有流程负责人及逐记录验证后再采用
sections.en: Tray is worth evaluating for a team that wants configurable cross-app workflows and can maintain payload mappings, authentication scopes and failure policy. It is less suitable if nobody can explain the source data shape or the operational meaning of continuing after an error. Follow a normal record, an optional-field omission and a duplicate business identifier through a test destination. App counts, AI-assisted authoring and customer stories do not replace that acceptance. No source-code license for the whole platform, interface localization or measured cost advantage was established here.
sections.zh: 当团队需要可配置跨应用流程，并能维护负载映射、认证范围与失败策略时，Tray 值得评估。如果无人能解释源数据结构或遇错继续的运营含义，适用性较弱。建议让正常记录、可选字段缺失及业务标识重复三种情况到达测试目标。应用数量、AI 辅助搭建及客户故事都不能替代验收。本文未确认整个平台源码许可、界面本地化或实测费用优势。

seo.description_en: Evaluate Tray.ai’s data paths, scoped authentication, loop/task consumption, error modes and private connectivity with current official sources.
